scripts.icons: npm run icons --prefix .. && node ../scripts/build-icon-types.mjs angular/src/app/icon/icon-name.ts && node ../scripts/build-icon-types.mjs react/src/icon/icon-name.ts && node ../scripts/build-icon-types.mjs vue/src/icon/icon-name.ts
scripts.assemble: mkdir -p dist/icons dist/css dist/html && cp ../icons/*.svg dist/icons/ && cp ../css/*.css dist/css/ && cp ../index.html dist/html/ && cp index.html dist/
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run icons && npm run build --workspaces && npm run assemble
scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve dist
